judged_text: saveChanges calls this.get('embedding').update({}) with an empty payload, so the save button wired into the update endpoint persists nothing and depends entirely on the no-op server handler to appear to succeed. Admins clicking any embedding-level save in the UI silently lose their action; the next change to this controller that assumes update persists state will be built on a path that provably writes nothing.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add `saveChanges()` in `app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, and the server `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` is a no-op that just re-serializes. However, the new UI template `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no save button and never wires any action to `saveChanges` (only `addHost`/`deleteHost` are used, and hosts are saved via `host.save(props)` in the component). So the claim that “admins clicking any embedding-level save in the UI silently lose their action” isn’t verifiable from this diff.
